A.notes: A has a clear editorial idea built around flame-marking and the warm, soft illustration style supports it well on desktop. Typography is the strongest part, but the mobile page shows large empty stretches and incomplete-feeling pacing that hurt craft and shopping clarity. From the scroll frames, motion reads as light reveal/parallax at most rather than a story-driven sequence, though reduced-motion fallback appears intact.
